et cum ceciderit unus quilibet in principio,

Sed hoc mihi videtur rectum esse consilium.

sicut cadere solet ros super terram:

And if he will enter into any city,
circumdabit omnis Israël civitati illi funes,
all of Israel shall encircle that city with ropes.

ut non reperiatur ne calculus quidem ex ea.
so that there may not be found even one small stone from it.”
Dixitque Absalom, et omnes viri Israël:
And Absalom, with all the men of Israel,
Melius est consilium Chusai Arachitæ, consilio Achitophel:
said: “The counsel of Hushai the Archite is better than the counsel of Ahithophel.”
Domini autem nutu dissipatum est consilium Achitophel utile,
So, by an act of the Lord, the useful counsel of Ahithophel was defeated,
ut induceret Dominus super Absalom malum.
in order that the Lord might lead evil over Absalom.
Et ait Chusai Sadoc et Abiathar sacerdotibus:
And Hushai said to the priests, Zadok and Abiathar:
Hoc et hoc modo consilium dedit Achitophel Absalom et senioribus Israël:
“Ahithophel gave counsel to Absalom and to the elders of Israel in this and that manner.
et ego tale et tale dedi consilium.

ut referrent ad regem David nuntium:
so that they might carry the report to king David.

illi vero concito gradu ingressi sunt domum cujusdam viri in Bahurim,

when they had not found them,

seeing that his counsel had not been done,

and Absalom crossed over the Jordan,

he and all the men of Israel with him.
Amasam vero constituit Absalom pro Joab super exercitum:
Truly, Absalom appointed Amasa in place of Joab over the army.
Amasa autem erat filius viri qui vocabatur Jetra de Jezraëli,
Now Amasa was the son of a man who was called Ithra of Jezrael,
qui ingressus est ad Abigail filiam Naas,
who entered to Abigail, the daughter of Nahash,
who was the mother of Joab.
Et castrametatus est Israël cum Absalom in terra Galaad.
And Israel made camp with Absalom in the land of Gilead.
And when David had arrived at the encampment, Shobi,
Sobi filius Naas de Rabbath filiorum Ammon,
the son of Nahash, from Rabbah, of the sons of Ammon,
et Machir filius Ammihel de Lodabar,
and Machir, the son of Ammiel of Lodebar,
and Barzillai, the Gileadite of Rogelim,
And they gave these to David
et populo qui cum eo erat,

suspicati enim sunt populum fame et siti fatigari in deserto.
